text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin enjoys the Osaka Hai to<n>her heart's
content, unburdened by<n>all that she had tried to
carry alone as<n>the older sister.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
No longer shackled by the feeling that<n>she's being
selfish by running, she<n>crosses the finish line with a
glowing<n>smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following the race, she feels an even<n>stronger
resolve to live up to the<n>dreams of the people
supporting her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When Ines tells me she's eyeing the<n>Takarazuka
Kinen, a race which fields<n>the most popular runners,
I give her<n>my full support without hesitation.
